svm.note: RM11: StandardScaler in preprocess; CalibratedClassifierCV(sigmoid); class_weight=balanced on LinearSVC/SVC; equal n_trials.

rf.note: RM11: broadened leaf/feature regularisation vs Slice 6.

mlp.note: Replaces ExtraTrees (M9): distinct inductive bias (shallow MLP) vs bagged trees; avoids near-duplicate RF/ExtraTrees pair.

frank_hall_rf.note: Frank–Hall ordinal reduction with RF binary thresholds (M8/RM11).

frank_hall_logistic.note: Frank–Hall ordinal reduction with logistic binary thresholds (M8).

coverage_size_abstention_tradeoff.note: Trade-off after RM2: |set|≥large_set_size is not auto-severe by duplicate rule; abstention proxy = fraction of sets that wide.

conformal.selection_note: M11/RM8: among methods meeting overall and grade-3 coverage, choose lowest wide-set abstention then smallest mean set; compare marginal, CV+, ordinal nonconformity, class-conditional grade-3 α and report the coverage–size–abstention trade-off. Prediction sets forced contiguous on the ordinal grade scale.

protocol_note: selection_biased: argmax pooled outer-OOF QWK over model×imputer. nested_unbiased: per outer fold pick model×imputer by inner QWK only. production (M10): model×imputer with best mean inner_qwk across outer folds (not mode-of-winners); fold-winner instability reported separately. pooled_oof vs mean_fold are both reported for every candidate. Decoding (RM10): argmax vs median compared by mean fold QWK on the same OOF; production decode_rule adopted only if it does not regress mean-inner selection. Capacity-matched multiclass vs ordinal in artefact.
candidate_table_note: F8: all model×imputer candidates with mean_fold_qwk_ci95 across outer folds.

selection_biased.note: Optimistic: model×imputer chosen using the same outer OOF scores reported.

nested_unbiased.note: Unbiased OOF: per outer fold pick by inner QWK. Production artefact uses best mean inner_qwk (M10), not mode-of-winners.

capacity_matched_multiclass_vs_ordinal.protocol: Capacity-matched: same imputer; multiclass family vs ordinal/Frank–Hall. ci95_delta_qwk = grouped bootstrap on OOF QWK_ord − QWK_multi when fold OOF vectors are supplied. Selection still uses best mean inner QWK (no silent M1 regression).

decode_rule_justification: Retained argmax: mean_fold QWK 0.6938 ≥ median 0.6873 on lightgbm__median; avoids silent M1 regression (RM10).

fusion_set_comparison.selection_rule: Among sets whose Δ-area CI vs best contains 0, choose simplest (order ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D']). Keep A if it still wins (RM7).
fusion_set_comparison.finding: Chosen set C; multi-channel reliability contributes.

component_auroc.note: AUROC of raw R_* vs OOF correctness. Near-chance r_data/r_physics justifies keeping locked set A unless set compare wins on RC area.

fusion_set_comparison.component_constants_justification: Production set C is selected by the declared risk-coverage rule; r_data/r_physics/r_uncertainty/r_stability are reported via component AUROC + fold coef sensitivity but do not enter R_final unless set compare selects B/C/D. Decision-band utilities are engineering-cost justified in stacker.DECISION_BAND_UTILITIES.

fusion_protocol: declared A-D set selected by risk-coverage rule; production stacker and calibrator fitted and reported on the identical served raw-score path; fold-stacker outputs retained only as diagnostics (RC3)

fusion_feature_report.n_missing_semantics: risk count, so AUROC<0.5 versus correctness is expected; coefficient is free-signed
fusion_feature_report.selection_rule: Among sets whose Δ-area CI vs best contains 0, choose simplest (order ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D']). Keep A if it still wins (RM7).

thresholds.utilities_justification: Asymmetric engineering cost: false accept (routine clear when wrong) is penalized at −1; correct accept rewarded +1; intermediate bands scale down both reward and penalty; abstain on error +0.3 (caught miss) vs abstain on correct −0.05 (extra review). Alternative: target_accept_rate mode below.
